title: Senior Packaging Technician, Operations (m/f/d)
description: Job Description The Senior Packaging Technician is responsible for independently executing clinical packaging activities in compliance with internal specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), batch records and applicable Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)/ Good Documentation Practice ( GDP ) and Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) requirements. This role performs primary and secondary packaging, operates packaging and labelling systems, supports documentation and SAP transactions, coordinates routine technical tasks within assigned studies and serves as an experienced technical point of contact for day-to-day packaging activities. Key Responsibilities: 1. Clinical Packaging Operations Performs primary packaging of clinical studies according to internal specifications, SOPs and batch records. Performs secondary packaging of clinical studies according to internal specifications, SOPs and batch records. Supplies ordered study material to the corresponding packaging rooms and prepares materials in accordance with the relevant SOPs. Operates packaging and labelling systems in support of clinical packaging activities. 2. Technical Coordination Trains and supports new technicians during onboarding and routine operations. Performs administrative work related to packaging orders and clinical packaging activities. Escalates problems directly to the supervisor or manager as required. Coordinates the execution of bottle filling, labelling and packaging activities for clinical studies. Oversees compliance-related aspects of packaging orders and serves as a technical point of contact for technicians assigned to individual studies. Performs cleaning verification for equipment and rooms and completes final cleaning verification at study closeout. Executes SAP transactions related to packaging activities. Prepares GMP documentation, including required photographs, and creates batch notes or comments as applicable. Reviews and coordinates Packaging Technicians’ activities within the assigned area. Supports the transfer of cold materials as required during daily operations. Ensures study completion and hands over completed studies to the supervisor. 3. Routine Operational Tasks Performs or coordinates routine tasks such as scale adjustments, deionized water flushes, and replenishment of consumables to support operational readiness. Provides day-to-day operational support to ensure readiness of packaging rooms, equipment and materials. Supports the Packaging Compliance Support team with batch pre- and post-execution reviews. 4. Documentation & Systems Assists in document preparation, control and process improvement for packaging activities. Uses SAP, Word and Excel for documentation and operational support, including the accurate completion of electronic logs. Ensures accurate and compliant use of SAP for clinical packaging processes. 5. Compliance & EHS Performs all activities in compliance with applicable SOPs, company policies, and GMP/GDP/EHS requirements. Documents activities in accordance with internal GDP requirements. Conducts blinding checks in accordance with SOP requirements. Required Skills: Aseptic Operations, Aseptic Operations, Biological Sciences, Cleanroom Gowning, Computer Literacy, GMP Compliance, GMP Documentation, GMP Training, Language Assessments, Legal Document Preparation, Life Science, Master Batch Records, Operations Support, Packaging Management, Packaging Processes, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Process Improvements, Production Scheduling, Safety Compliance, SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), SAP Governance Risk and Compliance (SAP GRC), SAP Quality Management (QM), Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Writing, Teamwork, Union Experience {+ 1 more} Preferred Skills: Current Employees apply HERE Current Contingent Workers apply HERE Secondary Language(s) Job Description: Your Profile: Completed apprenticeship, preferably in a life sciences-related field. At least 3 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, clinical packaging, or a comparable GMP-regulated environment. Good understanding of GMP, GDP and EHS requirements relevant to packaging operations. English language proficiency at B1/ B2 level or above. Hands-on experience with packaging and labelling equipment and routine operational support activities. Experience with documentation practices, batch records and accurate recording of operational activities. Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications such as Word and Excel. Ability to train and support other technicians and to serve as a technical point of contact for assigned studies. Reliable, detail-oriented and able to work independently while following procedures and compliance requirements. Demonstrates strong ethics, compliance and quality mindset. Strong team player with a collaborative mindset. Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset in day-to-day operations and supports the implementation of procedural changes. THE COMPANY Our Company is a leading biopharmaceutical company employing over 1,000 people in Switzerland at three sites. The company’s headquarters are in Lucerne. At the site in Zurich, the company operates a global innovation and development hub. In addition, we manufacture medicines for global clinical trials and operate a forensic laboratory in Schachen (Canton Lucerne). We conduct around 40 clinical trials annually in Switzerland. The main therapeutic areas include oncology, infectious diseases, cardiovascular and cardiometabolic diseases. We also have a broad portfolio of vaccines for the prevention of diseases in children, adolescents, and adults and we are one of the leading companies in veterinary medicine. Furthermore, we take our responsibility to the local community seriously and have been involved for many years in initiatives such as the «Trendtage Gesundheit Luzern» and the «Alliance Health Competence». We are proud to be certified as a “Top Employer Switzerland” and “Top Employer Europe” showing the company’s commitment to our employees and the community around us . Our Werthenstein BioPharma site in Schachen is where we conduct cutting-edge research, develop and analyze new biological agents and supply clinical trial products for global clinical studies. The site is also home to one of our global forensic laboratories where we carefully monitor our products through the supply chain to ensure security and safety for our patients. title: Vision Engineer
description: Job Description Breng data tot leven en maak zichtbaar impact binnen onze high tech vaccinomgeving als: Vision Engineer Welkom in ons team De site Boxmeer maakt deel uit van ons Animal Health netwerk en produceert en verpakt diergeneesmiddelen voor de wereldwijde markt. De afdeling Live Vaccines bestaat uit CFFD, SFFD, Improvement en Maintenance & Reliability (M&R). Binnen de afdeling werken ongeveer 280 medewerkers gedurende 7 dagen per week aan het formuleren, vullen en vriesdrogen van levende (steriele) vaccins volgens GMP en EHS wet- en regelgeving. Het Visuele Inspectie/Vacuüm Testen (VI/VT) team bestaat uit ongeveer 50 medewerkers. Over de rol Als Vision Engineer rapporteer je aan de VI/VT Lead en speel je een belangrijke rol in het optimaliseren van het automatische visuele inspectie en vacuümtestproces binnen de VI/VT afdeling van SFFD. Je ontwikkelt en verfijnt vision algoritmes die machines in staat stellen visuele data te interpreteren en betrouwbare beslissingen te nemen. In deze functie combineer je operationele kennis met automatiseringsexpertise en fungeer je als verbindende schakel tussen proces en machine. Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams aan de ontwikkeling en implementatie van een nieuwe standaard voor visuele inspectie, volledig in lijn met Annex 1, voor zowel vloeibare als gevriesdroogde producten op de site Boxmeer. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden omvatten • Ontwikkelen, optimaliseren en onderhouden van vision algoritmes voor automatische visuele inspectie en vacuümtesten. • Analyseren en interpreteren van visuele data om inspectieprestaties en procesbetrouwbaarheid te verbeteren. • Actieve bijdrage aan troubleshooting op de productielijn en het uitvoeren van root cause analyses bij afwijkingen. • Opleiden en ondersteunen van operators en technici in het gebruik en begrip van vision systemen. • Meewerken binnen projectteams aan de ontwikkeling en implementatie van de nieuwe visuele inspectiestandaard conform Annex 1. • Nauwe samenwerking met productieteams en ondersteunende afdelingen zoals M&R, Improvement, Quality Assurance, Quality Control en Global Support Functions. Jouw profiel • Een afgeronde bacheloropleiding (hbo of wo) in Mechatronica, Elektrotechniek, Technische Informatica, Informatica/AI of een vergelijkbare richting. Een masteropleiding is een pré. • Minimaal 3- 5 jaar relevante werkervaring, bij voorkeur met industriële machine‑vision‑toepassingen in een productieomgeving (bijvoorbeeld binnen pharma, food, automotive of packaging), inclusief hands‑on ervaring met vision‑software. • Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met oog voor gestructureerde documentatie en heldere communicatie met allerlei stakeholders. • Kennis van productietechnologieën, GMP‑richtlijnen en Lean Six Sigma‑principes, of de motivatie om je hierin verder te verdiepen. • Goede beheersing van projectmanagementvaardigheden en aantoonbare ervaring met het begeleiden en realiseren van veranderingen. • Affiniteit met programmeren en een goed begrip van software‑engineeringprincipes; ervaring hiermee is een plus. • Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal, in woord en geschrift. description: Job Description The Global Clinical Supply (GCS) organization manages the “end-to-end” clinical supply for the company’s portfolio. GCS is accountable for the planning, sourcing, labeling, packaging and delivery of clinical supplies to clinical sites across more than 60+ countries, in compliance with worldwide regulations, company policies and standard operating procedures. The Operational Supply Chain Planning Lead is responsible for creating, maintaining, and continuously improving the overarching packaging & release plan across all clinical supply sites. This role provides portfolio-level visibility to packaging demand, site capacity, operational constraints, and emerging supply risks, including re-sitings across the internal and external network. The successful candidate will work across GCS and external partners to translate portfolio priorities into executable planning assumptions, drive alignment on internal capacity and siting decisions, and proactively escalate risks with clear mitigation options. This position also supports key cross-functional initiatives that advance GCS’s mission by improving planning discipline, strengthening supply chain health, and enabling reliable, compliant delivery of clinical supplies to global clinical studies. Primary activities include, but are not limited to: Develop, maintain, and govern the portfolio-level packaging plan across GCS packaging sites, ensuring planning assumptions are current, transparent, and aligned to clinical program priorities. Monitor internal site capacity, packaging demand, campaign timing, and operational constraints to identify potential bottlenecks, trade-offs, and downstream impacts across the clinical supply network. Partner with Clinical Supply Project Managers, Packaging Operations, Quality, Release Planning, Distribution, and external stakeholders to ensure packaging plans remain executable, compliant, and responsive to changing study needs. Lead scenario planning and risk mitigation discussions for capacity constraints, timeline changes, supply interruptions, re-sitings, urgent portfolio shifts, and other events that may impact clinical supply continuity. Serve as a subject matter expert for operational supply chain planning practices, providing guidance to stakeholders on planning standards, governance expectations, and issue resolution. Lead and manage the Clinical Supply Operations (CSO) planning & release team, support onboarding and training, and contribute to change management activities that build planning capability across the organization. title: Responsable de Esterilidades
description: Job Description Ha surgido una oportunidad para un/a Responsable de Laboratorio de Ensayos de Esterilidad en el área de Control de Calidad en entorno de Industria farmacéutica bajo normas GMP. Esta posición dirigirá y asegurará el funcionamiento integral del laboratorio de ensayos de esterilidad y microbiología asociado, garantizando resultados fiables, oportunos y en cumplimiento de las Buenas Prácticas de Fabricación (GMP), las farmacopeas y los procedimientos internos. El puesto gestionará recursos, instalaciones, sistemas y la mejora continua necesarios para optimizar el estado del laboratorio. Su alcance incluye ensayos de esterilidad por filtración por membrana e inoculación directa; lectura, interpretación y documentación de resultados; y gestión del personal, planificación de capacidad, materiales, medios de cultivo, reactivos, cepas, equipos y áreas clasificadas. Requiere presencia habitual en áreas de laboratorio y, cuando corresponda, acceso a zonas clasificadas conforme a los requisitos de vestimenta y cualificación. Puede requerir disponibilidad para responder a incidencias críticas, auditorías, inspecciones o necesidades operativas fuera del horario habitual. Qué harás Aportarás energía, conocimiento, innovación y liderazgo para llevar a cabo lo siguiente: Asegurar el cumplimiento GMP y la gobernanza de calidad: ejecutar las actividades conforme a GMP, farmacopeas vigentes, autorizaciones de comercialización y procedimientos internos; mantener la preparación permanente del laboratorio para auditorías e inspecciones; liderar la respuesta y el cierre de observaciones; y planificar, priorizar y supervisar la recepción de muestras, ejecución de ensayos, incubación, lecturas, revisión de datos y emisión de resultados dentro de los plazos acordados. Gestionar los controles y la continuidad operativa del laboratorio: establecer controles para medios de cultivo, reactivos, cepas, materiales y consumibles, incluidos recepción, liberación, promoción de crecimiento, almacenamiento, caducidad e inventario; gestionar la capacidad y continuidad operativa, anticipando cargas de trabajo, restricciones, mantenimientos y contingencias. Asegurar instalaciones, control ambiental y prevención de contaminación: garantizar que el ensayo se realice en condiciones asépticas apropiadas y que el diseño, flujo de personal y materiales, limpieza y desinfección reduzcan el riesgo de contaminación; supervisar el programa de monitorización ambiental y de personal, sus límites, alertas, acciones, tendencias y respuestas ante excursiones. Gestionar resultados, desviaciones, investigaciones, métodos y equipos: evaluar y escalar inmediatamente eventos por resultados positivos, atípicos o fuera de especificación; liderar o supervisar investigaciones científicamente sólidas sobre fallos de esterilidad, desviaciones, excursiones ambientales y errores de laboratorio; asegurar la transferencia, verificación, validación o adecuación de los métodos antes de su uso rutinario y mantener su estado validado; asegurar la cualificación, calibración, mantenimiento preventivo y gestión de averías de equipos y sistemas informatizados. Garantizar integridad de datos, gestión de cambios y mejora continua: asegurar que los registros electrónicos cumplan los requisitos de integridad de datos, acceso, trazabilidad, revisión y conservación; evaluar y aprobar, según autoridad, cambios en métodos, equipos, instalaciones, sistemas, proveedores, materiales y programas de monitorización antes de su implantación; impulsar simplificación, digitalización, automatización y nuevas tecnologías sin comprometer el cumplimiento ni el control microbiológico. Liderar personas, seguridad, bioseguridad y sostenibilidad: definir la estructura del equipo, asignar responsabilidades y asegurar capacidad suficiente para la carga y criticidad de las operaciones; seleccionar, formar, cualificar y recualificar al personal en técnica aséptica, vestimenta, métodos, seguridad, GMP e integridad de datos; fijar objetivos, realizar seguimiento del desempeño, desarrollar capacidades y fomentar liderazgo, colaboración y responsabilidad individual; asegurar el cumplimiento de los requisitos de seguridad laboral, bioseguridad, higiene industrial y gestión de residuos biológicos; promover prácticas seguras y la notificación de incidentes. Se valorará experiencia en inspecciones regulatorias, aisladores, sistemas LIMS, identificación microbiana y mejora continua. ¿Por qué unirte a nosotros? title: Associate Principal Scientist, Small Molecule Chemical Engineering
description: Job Description Associate Principal Scientist, Engineering Chemical Commercialization Technology (CCT) The Chemical Commercialization Technology (CCT) department, part of our Manufacturing Division, is seeking a highly motivated and collaborative scientist to join our team. This position offers the opportunity to provide technical leadership across a varied portfolio of late-stage small molecule development programs while working in a highly integrated environment with research, manufacturing, quality, regulatory and external partners. The Associate Principal Scientist, Engineering, will leverage deep scientific and engineering knowledge to develop safe, robust, scalable, and commercially viable manufacturing processes. The role encompasses process characterization, technology transfer, process validation, regulatory filing support, commercial launch readiness and global supply support for late-stage pipeline and commercial products. The successful candidate will lead teams in the application of scientific and risk-based approaches to process understanding and control strategy development. This includes the use of Quality Risk Management (QRM), statistical design of experiments (DOE), process modeling, and data analytics to enhance process robustness and ensure reliable product supply. This position combines laboratory and pilot-scale experimental work with direct engagement at commercial manufacturing facilities. The scientist will be expected to provide strategic technical leadership during scale-up, process validation, technology transfer and manufacturing investigations while mentoring junior scientists and engineers. The candidate must demonstrate a strong commitment to safety, quality, and compliance, including adherence to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs), Good Documentation Practices (GDPs), data integrity principles, and participation in risk assessments, deviation investigations, change control activities and continuous improvement initiatives. Key Responsibilities Lead technical development, scale-up, and commercialization of small molecule drug substance manufacturing processes. Design and execute process characterization studies to establish process understanding and define commercial operating ranges. Apply Quality Risk Management (QRM), Quality by Design (QbD) and statistical methodologies to develop robust control strategies. Provide technical leadership for technology transfer activities to pilot plant and commercial manufacturing sites. Support process validation, continued process verification, regulatory submissions and post-approval change implementation. Collaborate effectively with Manufacturing, Process Research, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain and external partners to resolve complex technical issues. Lead investigations associated with process deviations, yield improvements, impurity control and process robustness. Mentor and develop junior scientists and engineers through technical coaching and project leadership. Drive innovation through the application of advanced process technologies, digital tools, modeling and data analytics where appropriate. Position Qualifications Education Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering or a related scientific discipline with a minimum of 4 years of relevant industrial experience following completion of the Ph.D. OR B.S. or M.S. in Chemical Engineering or a related scientific discipline with a minimum of 8 years of relevant industrial experience. Required Experience and Skills Demonstrated expertise in chemical process development and scale-up for pharmaceutical or specialty chemical manufacturing. Proven ability to independently design, execute, interpret, and communicate experimental studies aimed at improving process understanding, robustness, productivity and control strategy development. Experience supporting technology transfer from laboratory development through pilot plant and commercial manufacturing. Strong technical leadership and project management capabilities in cross-functional environments. Ability to mentor and develop scientists and engineers through technical guidance and coaching. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Demonstrated problem-solving capabilities using scientific and engineering principles. Ability to collaborate effectively across technical, quality, regulatory and manufacturing functions. Preferred Experience and Skills Hands-on experience with unit operations commonly employed in small molecule drug substance API development and manufacturing, including chemical reactions, workup operations, filtration, drying, crystallization and particle engineering. Experience leading process characterization, validation strategy development, and process performance qualification (PPQ) activities. Experience authoring or contributing to regulatory submissions and responding to health authority questions. Expertise in statistical experimental design and data analysis tools (e.g., JMP, Minitab, or equivalent). Experience supporting commercial manufacturing, lifecycle management, and post-approval process changes. Familiarity with mathematical modeling, process simulation, mechanistic understanding and scale-up principles. Experience applying digital, data science, or advanced manufacturing technologies to accelerate process development and commercialization. title: Senior Scientist, Small Molecule Chemical Engineering
description: Job Description The Chemical Commercialization Technology (CCT) department, part of our Manufacturing Division, is seeking a highly motivated and collaborative scientist to join our team. This position offers the opportunity to provide technical leadership across a varied portfolio of late-stage small molecule development programs while working in a highly integrated environment with research, manufacturing, quality, regulatory and external partners. The Senior Scientist will apply chemical engineering and process development expertise to support the commercialization of late-stage and commercial small molecule drug substance processes. This role provides significant technical leadership and offers opportunities to influence process design, control strategies, technology transfers, validation programs, regulatory submissions, and lifecycle process improvements. The successful candidate will work across laboratory, pilot plant, and manufacturing environments to develop scientific understanding, assess process risks, and implement robust manufacturing solutions. The individual will collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners to drive successful commercialization and continuous improvement initiatives. The candidate must demonstrate a strong commitment to safety, quality, and compliance, including adherence to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs), Good Documentation Practices (GDPs), data integrity principles, and participation in risk assessments, deviation investigations, change control activities and continuous improvement initiatives. Key Responsibilities Lead process understanding, characterization, and commercialization activities for small molecule drug substance manufacturing processes. Design and execute scientifically sound experimental programs using Quality Risk Management (QRM) and Quality by Design (QbD) principles. Apply statistical methods, Design of Experiments (DoE), and data-driven decision making to establish process robustness and control strategies. Develop, defend, and communicate technical recommendations to cross-functional teams, manufacturing sites, and senior leadership. Support technology transfer activities from development laboratories to pilot plants and commercial manufacturing facilities. Author and review technical reports, validation documents, regulatory filing content, control strategies, and lifecycle management documentation. Provide technical leadership during process performance qualification (PPQ), process validation, and commercial manufacturing campaigns. Lead or support investigations, risk assessments, change controls, deviations, and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs). Collaborate with internal and external manufacturing partners to resolve technical challenges and implement process improvements. Utilize first-principles engineering, process modeling, and scale-up methodologies to support manufacturing and process optimization. Champion a culture of safety, compliance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Position Qualifications Education Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering or a related scientific discipline. OR B.S. or M.S. in Chemical Engineering or a related scientific discipline with a minimum of 5 years of relevant industrial experience. Required Experience and Skills Demonstrated experience in chemical process development, commercialization, or manufacturing support of small molecule pharmaceutical processes. Experience designing and executing experimental programs to solve complex chemical engineering and manufacturing challenges. Effective communication skills with the ability to present technical information to multiple audiences. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in multidisciplinary teams. Strong organizational, project management, and technical writing skills. Demonstrated commitment to safety, quality, and compliance. Preferred Experience and Skills Experience authoring or reviewing regulatory submissions (e.g., NDA, MAA, post-approval changes). Experience leading technology transfers between development, pilot plant, and commercial manufacturing environments. Hands-on expertise with unit operations commonly used in small molecule drug substance manufacturing, including; Chemical reactions, Work-up operations, Distillation, Crystallization, Filtration, Drying. Knowledge of statistical software and advanced data analysis tools (e.g., JMP, Minitab, Python). Experience applying Design of Experiments (DoE), Process Capability Analysis, and Multivariate Data Analysis. Familiarity with process analytical technologies (PAT), digital manufacturing tools, and advanced process monitoring approaches. Experience leading internal / external technical discussions. Knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), validation requirements, and pharmaceutical quality systems. Experience with mathematical modeling, process simulation, scale-up principles, and engineering calculations. Familiarity with ICH guidelines, Quality by Design (QbD), Quality Risk Management (QRM), and lifecycle process verification concepts. description: Job Description Position Overview - Basic Functions & Responsibility Essential function{s) includes, but is not limited to: Reporting to the Associate Director of PTO Engineering, the Senior Specialist Engineer is responsible for providing technical support of our Manufacturing Division-Wilson packaging (including bottle/blister/oral solid dose filling and packaging lines) and medical device (autoinjector assembly and packaging/combination kit packaging) lines. Work requires a strong technical background and project management skills, as well as working knowledge of our company's methods, standards, procedures, and practices. Experience in equipment installation and qualification for complex systems. This position requires the engineer to be the technical subject matter expert for the assigned packaging lines and to make recommendations for decisions associated with these lines and their associated products. Utilizes strong communication skills to lead project sub teams or be a key contributor on site and above-site sub teams. Leads implementation of new technology and new applications of existing technology. The Senior Process/Project Engineer will also provide leadership and training to others. This includes support for equipment design, equipment qualification, process demonstration, process performance qualification, and process validation including for bottle/blister/autoinjector packaging equipment. Responsible for managing capital and expense projects for installation and qualification of new packaging and medical device assembly equipment and modifications/optimizations to existing equipment. Review literature pertaining to pharmaceutical packaging in order to introduce new profitable/productivity ideas into the packaging operation. Provides technical support in critically evaluating quality standard specifications and methods for raw materials and intermediate and final products. Provide technical support for the design, machinability evaluation, process performance qualification and qualification of new or modified packaging components and Medical Device and Combination products. Technical support for the scale-up and technology transfer of pilot processes to production scale for our Manufacturing Division -Wilson. This includes support for equipment design, equipment qualification, process demonstration, process performance qualification, and process validation. Responsible for authoring process change controls and completing tasks to implement packaging and device assembly equipment/process changes. Provides technical assistance for quality and regulatory activities including site inspections and preparation of technical documents for FDA observation. description: Job Description The Global Pharma pipeline holds significant promise across areas of high unmet medical need, particularly in cardiometabolic disease, with multiple assets advancing into Phase II and III. With late-stage development programs and anticipated launches, Global Pharma is well positioned to drive future growth and meaningful patient impact. Within Global Pharma team, it’s an exciting time as we build an industry-leading cardiometabolic & Neuroscience business that aspires to impact these devastating diseases on a global scale. Our company has made significant progress with advancing our cardiometabolic and rare disease pipeline this year. Moreover, we expect 8 approvals in the next five years across our broad and exciting portfolio. The Executive Director, Global Commercial Leader, Cardiometabolic will lead three key pipeline products within our company’s expanding cardiometabolic portfolio, with a focus on MASH, obesity & inflammation. These assets have the potential to become best-in-class products and generate blockbuster revenue. In addition, the team will continue to manage inline diabetes brands and our alliance with Bayer. The Global Commercial Leader will play an important role in supporting the commercial transformation and leadership of our launches, pipeline including new ways of working, embedding advanced analytics, evolving the commercial models and building value for patients, payers and HCP. This role will also support the commercial leadership in our Business Development efforts to help support growth and leadership in this space. title: Bioprocess Technician
description: Job Description Breng wetenschap en techniek samen in een dynamische bioprocess rol, waarin je werkt met geavanceerde technologieën en directe impact hebt op de ontwikkeling van vaccins die de diergezondheid wereldwijd verbeteren! Voor onze Animal Health location Boxmeer zoeken we een: Bioprocess Technician Welkom in ons team De afdeling Bioreactor Facility Boxmeer (BFB) produceert geinactiveerde antigenen op basis van grootschalige celcultuur (suspensie) in gesloten 2.000 ltr bioreactoren. De afdeling bestaat uit 2 process lijnen met elk USP (Up Stream Processes) en DSP (Down Stream Processes). Daarnaast worden deze process lijnen door een Support (logistiek) team ondersteunt. Je komt terecht in een high tech en biotechnologische omgeving met een hoge dynamiek. Over de functie Als Bioprocess Technician bij BFB ben je verantwoordelijk voor alle activiteiten die nodig zijn voor de productie van een kwalitatief goed en veilig antigeen. Rooted in direct experience on the farm and in the clinic, we work hand in hand with our customers every step of the way. Our singular focus is to empower those who care for animals, helping them manage their vital responsibility with confidence. Because when it comes to animal health, no one sees it like we do. Our Manufacturing Operations teams are the people that make our products. We work in the manufacturing plants with a “Safety First, Quality Always” mindset striving for continuous improvement. We work in the local plant linked to our global manufacturing network to ensure the highest quality of raw materials, intermediates, and finished products. title: Reliability Quality Automation Engineer
description: Job Description Our Company is an innovative, global healthcare leader committed to improving health and well-being in 140 countries around the world. Our product categories include heart and respiratory health, diabetes, infectious diseases, consumer products and women’s health. We aspire to be the best healthcare company in the world and are dedicated to providing innovative solutions for tomorrow. QA Automation Engineer We are seeking an experienced QA Automation Engineer to join our dynamic team and drive quality engineering excellence across enterprise digital solutions. The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on expertise in Robot Framework, Python-based automation, API and backend testing, and CI/CD practices. This role will play a key part in advancing automation capabilities across the testing lifecycle, leveraging Gen AI to accelerate test design, test data creation, automation script development and optimization, defect analysis, and continuous improvement of test effectiveness and maintainability, while ensuring adherence to quality, compliance, and security standards. Responsibilities Design, develop, execute, and maintain scalable automated test suites using Robot Framework, with a focus on reliability, reusability, maintainability, and seamless integration into CI/CD pipelines. Write and maintain Python scripts for automation tasks, ensuring robust and scalable test processes. Maintain and continuously improve automated tests to ensure they remain effective and up to date with the latest application changes and requirements. Collaborate with product owners, developers, business analysts, and cross-functional QA teams to define test requirements, design automation strategies, review risks, and ensure test coverage is aligned with business priorities and release objectives. Demonstrate a strong understanding of all phases of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), including test planning, test design, test execution, defect logging, defect tracking, and closure. Identify, document, and track software defects and issues, ensuring they are resolved promptly and effectively. Continuously evaluate and apply modern QA tools, automation practices, and AI-assisted testing approaches to improve test coverage, reduce manual effort, increase delivery speed, and strengthen overall product quality. Apply Gen AI tools and prompt engineering techniques to accelerate test design, generate and optimize automation scripts, support test data creation, summarize defects and execution results, and identify opportunities to improve automation quality, maintainability, and delivery efficiency. Use Gen AI responsibly by validating generated outputs, protecting confidential data, following company-approved tools and policies, and applying human review before incorporating AI-generated test assets into delivery pipelines. Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technology discipline. A minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience as an automation quality assurance engineer in a reputable organization. Proficiency in the Robot Framework and Selenium for automated testing. Strong knowledge of Python for writing and maintaining automation scripts. Experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, especially GitHub Actions. Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker). Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub). Experience with API, backend, and integration testing, including validation of service contracts, data flows, error handling, and system-to-system reliability. Solid understanding of SDLC processes. Hands-on experience using Gen AI tools for QA activities, including prompt engineering, test scenario generation, automation script creation or refactoring, test data support, defect summarization, and validation of AI-generated outputs. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Effective communication and collaboration skills within cross-functional teams. Ability to adapt to new tools and methodologies to enhance testing efficiency. Experience working in Agile Scrum, Kanban, and Waterfall delivery models. Preferred Experience in the Pharmaceutical or Healthcare domain. Expertise in API testing to ensure integration reliability and performance. Experience in mobile testing across various devices and platforms. Understanding of SQL (Structured Query Language). Experience with test management tools like JIRA XRAY. Familiarity with enterprise Gen AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, GPT-based assistants, or similar technologies, with an understanding of how they can support QA automation, documentation, analysis, and productivity improvements. description: Job Description 🚀 Calibration Technician Are you an expert in keeping critical manufacturing systems running smoothly and accurately? We are looking for a skilled Calibration Technician to join our integrated production team. In this hands-on role, you will be the guardian of our process instrumentation—ensuring everything is accurate, compliant, and fit for purpose to support top-tier manufacturing, product quality, and site reliability. If you thrive in a dynamic, Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) environment and enjoy diagnosing complex faults while balancing planned maintenance with urgent production demands, this is the role for you. 🎯 What You Will Do As a vital part of our Engineering and Calibration Group, you will take ownership of your tasks, working closely with engineers, production teams, and external suppliers. Core Responsibilities Systems & Equipment You'll Master Calibration & Maintenance: Execute planned calibrations, fault-finding, and corrective repairs to minimize downtime. Measurement: Temperature (RTDs/thermocouples), pressure, flow, level, and humidity sensors. Testing & Commissioning: Support the installation, loop checking, and qualification of new instrumentation. Analytical & Control: pH/conductivity probes, process control, and electro-pneumatic systems. Quality & Compliance: Identify, report, and investigate out-of-tolerance (OOS) results while maintaining strict GMP records. Facilities: HVAC, autoclaves, sterilization systems, and core utilities (steam, water, air). Safety First: Actively champion site safety, strictly adhering to Permit to Work systems (e.g., confined space, electrical, height). Technical Skills: Strong ability to interpret P&IDs, wiring schematics, and instrument loop drawings. Industry Experience: Background in a GMP-regulated pharma, biotech, or medical device facility. Hands-On Expertise: Proven competence with calibration standards, measurement principles, and test equipment. Systems Knowledge: Familiarity with PLC, SCADA, BMS (Building), and EMS (Environmental) systems. Flexibility: Willingness to participate in weekend/out-of-hours overtime and breakdown call-out rotas. Continuous Improvement: Experience participating in deviations, investigations, and corrective actions. ✨ Ready to Make an Impact? You will be joining a culture that values high standards of workmanship, quality, and workplace safety. If you have the technical expertise and the drive to keep complex manufacturing operations running at their best, apply today to join our engineering team! title: Associate Director Policy
description: Job Description Wil jij strategische impact maken in de zorg, waar beleid en patiëntbelang samenkomen? In deze senior rol verbind je beleid, patiënten en stakeholders en zet je complexe vraagstukken om in tastbare resultaten. Welkom in ons team Patiënten vormen de kern van ons werk. De missie van ons bedrijf is om het leven van patiënten te redden en te verbeteren. De afdeling Policy, Communications & Patiënt Advocacy (PCPA) is verantwoordelijk voor de positionering van ons bedrijf bij patiënten , politiek , pers, publiek en personeel . Bijvoorbeeld via samenwerking met overheids - en patiëntenorganisaties , public affairs, mediarelaties , corporate externe - en interne communicatie . Over de rol Als Associate Director Policy richt je je op het optimaliseren van het investeringsklimaat in Nederland voor ons bedrijf. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s in cross-functionele teams en draagt ook actief bij aan belangenbehartigingsstrategieën voor bijvoorbeeld productlanceringen. In deze rol ben je de zichtbare strateeg met sterke inhoudelijke kennis die moeiteloos coalities bouwt, zowel binnen onze organisatie als daarbuiten. Je schakelt 360 graden en beweegt je soepel tussen politieke stakeholders, maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen, patiëntenverenigingen en brancheverenigingen. Cross-functionele samenwerking zit in je DNA. Je kijkt verder dan je eigen rol en draagt actief bij aan gezamenlijke doelstellingen. Je signaleert vroegtijdig relevante ontwikkelingen in de buitenwereld én binnen de organisatie, en vertaalt deze naar heldere impactanalyses en strategische uitvoeringsplannen. Je bent in staat kennis over te brengen binnen en buiten de organisatie. Je werkt gestructureerd en borgt een goede monitoring van voortgang, waarover je regelmatig heldere rapportages oplevert. Bij nieuwe productla nceringen ben jij de strategisch adviseur die collega's en managers helpt om complexe vraagstukken om te zetten in concrete kansen en uitvoerbare acties. Je onderhoudt waardevolle relaties met politieke stakeholders, overheid, brancheverenigingen, patiëntenverenigingen en weet precies wie je waar nodig hebt om resultaat te boeken. Als wendbare professional combineer je het ad-hoc inspelen op actuele ontwikkelingen moeiteloos met het koershouden binnen onze midden- en langetermijnstrategie. Je rapporteert aan de Director Policy, Communication and Patient Advocacy . Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bouwen van coalities en het onderhouden van relaties met externe stakeholders zoals patiëntenverenigingen , brancheorganisaties en politieke contacten . title: Automation Engineer
description: Job Description Gaat jouw hart sneller kloppen van automatisering, IT-vraagstukken en werken in een dynamische productieomgeving? Wil jij met jouw technische expertise bijdragen aan een betrouwbare productieomgeving waarin geneesmiddelen veilig en efficiënt worden verpakt? Dan maken wij graag kennis met jou. Voor onze productieafdelingen in Haarlem zijn wij op zoek naar een: Automation Engineer Welkom in ons team Welkom bij Packaging Services. Ons team bestaat uit tien engineers met uiteenlopende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus. We helpen nieuwe collega's graag op weg en geloven dat we het meeste leren door kennis en ervaring met elkaar te delen. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat de computersystemen waarmee wij onze geneesmiddelen verpakken betrouwbaar, beschikbaar en toekomstbestendig blijven. We lossen acute storingen op, voeren preventief onderhoud uit en realiseren verbeterprojecten die bijdragen aan een nog efficiënter productieproces. Dat varieert van kleine optimalisaties tot complexe technische uitdagingen. Je komt terecht in een hecht en collegiaal team waarin samenwerking centraal staat. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met operators, operational coaches en andere ondersteunende teams die dagelijks bijdragen aan het succesvol verpakken van geneesmiddelen voor patiënten wereldwijd. Over de functie Als Automation Engineer speel je een sleutelrol binnen de IPT's (Integrated Process Teams). Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheer, de betrouwbaarheid en de continuïteit van de IT-systemen die essentieel zijn voor onze productie- en verpakkingsprocessen. Jij zorgt ervoor dat productiecollega's kunnen vertrouwen op een stabiele en robuuste IT-omgeving, zodat zij zich volledig kunnen richten op hun werkzaamheden. Hiervoor werk je intensief samen met andere automation engineers, interne stakeholders en externe leveranciers. Daarnaast ben jij hét aanspreekpunt voor IT-gerelateerde vraagstukken en storingen binnen de afdeling. Naast operationele ondersteuning ben je actief betrokken bij projecten. Vanaf de initiatie tot en met de oplevering vertegenwoordig je de afdeling, bewaak je de voortgang, coördineer je acties en stuur je waar nodig bij. Samen met je collega's realiseer je duurzame oplossingen binnen een omgeving waarin kwaliteit, compliance en regelgeving centraal staan. Omdat onze productieomgeving in drieploegendienst opereert, werk jij in dagdienst en neem je daarnaast deel aan een consignatiedienst. Primaire verantwoordelijkheden Als Automation Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor een betrouwbare, robuuste en toekomstbestendige IT-omgeving op de productievloer. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Analyseren en oplossen van IT-vraagstukken die impact hebben op de continuïteit, kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van onze productieprocessen. Fungeren als eerste aanspreekpunt voor IT-gerelateerde storingen en technische vraagstukken binnen de afdeling. Faciliteren van sessies met collega's en andere afdelingen, zoals Technical Operations en het Global IT-team, om tot effectieve en duurzame oplossingen te komen. Actief delen van technische kennis en expertise met technicians, operational managers en collega's binnen het team. Vertegenwoordigen van de afdeling binnen projecten en bijdragen aan succesvolle implementaties van nieuwe systemen, processen en verbeteringen. Leveren van input vanuit productieperspectief aan multidisciplinaire projectteams. Optreden als inhoudelijk expert en adviseren over standaarden op het gebied van automatisering, waaronder serialisatieprocessen. Actief deelnemen aan Global Communities of Practice, zoals het wereldwijde serialisatieteam, en bijdragen aan kennisdeling en standaardisatie. Overige verantwoordelijkheden Ondersteunen van automatiseringsprojecten binnen multidisciplinaire projectteams, waaronder het opstellen en beoordelen van scope-, ontwerp- en kwalificatiedocumentatie en het begeleiden of uitvoeren van testen. Beheer van één of meerdere applicaties binnen de MES-, Antares- en Systech-domeinen. Ondersteuning bieden tijdens audits en inspecties. IT-systemen beheren volgens de standaard: System Development Lifecycle (SDLC). Bewaken van lokale en internationale normen en standaarden op het gebied van procesautomatisering, zoals GAMP, 21 CFR Part 11 en Data Integrity. Jouw profiel Je hebt een afgeronde hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in Elektrotechniek, Industriële Automatisering, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare technische richting. Je hebt bij voorkeur kennis van GMP-richtlijnen en internationale IT-standaarden. Je hebt ervaring met netwerken,TCP/IP en Machinebesturingssystemen. And you can be part of it from day one. This is your opportunity to make a real impact and help build an organization where innovation, quality, and collaboration go hand in hand. Together, we create an environment where your expertise truly makes a difference—not only in our processes, but in the health of millions of animals worldwide. Improvement Officer - Start-up of a new pharmaceutical facility Welcome to your new team You will be working at the largest and most versatile pharmaceutical company in the Netherlands. For over 130 years, we have been developing solutions to address the greatest medical challenges. Research, development, production, and packaging - all take place here, in the Netherlands. Together with 5,000 colleagues in North Holland and Brabant, you contribute daily to building a safe, sustainable, and healthy future for both humans and animals. Our Animal Health site in Boxmeer is globally leading in vaccines and veterinary medicines. You work closely with engineering, quality, and operations to ensure everything is ready for a successful launch. You don’t just ensure the factory run - you make sure it excels. What will you do? In this versatile role, you combine subject-matter expertise with continuous improvement and development: You optimize processes and share your knowledge by delivering training. You initiate and lead technical improvements, such as updates in process automation. You support the implementation of new equipment and ways of working. You assist with product transfers and optimizations. You manage and maintain production data in SAP. You prepare change controls for modifications in processes or equipment. You analyze data, identify trends, and perform root cause analyses. You collaborate with Maintenance & Reliability on maintenance improvements. You are the go-to expert in process software. You identify deviations and translate them into concrete improvement actions. You lead or contribute to projects where the solution is not yet defined. You review and improve protocols, logbooks, and work instructions. Supporting the implementation of production processes and systems (such as MES/EBR, OEE+, RTMS and MDH) . What do you bring? A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree (HBO level) and 3 years of experience in a pharmaceutical, chemical, or food environment. Experience with Lean / Six Sigma. Knowledge of GMP, production processes, and preferably automation (MES/EBR). Strong communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Fluency in Dutch or English. A team-oriented mindset and a passion for improvement, building, and delivering results. Why you want this role You help build a brand-new facility from the ground up. You have direct, visible impact. You work with the latest technologies. You contribute to animal health worldwide. You join an organization with a strong reputation and future potential. What we offer The opportunity to contribute to the health and well-being of both animals and people, within a stable environment where collaboration and collegiality come first. In addition, you can expect: A competitive salary based on your knowledge and experience. A 3% year-end allowance and an annual bonus based on individual and company performance. A minimum of 35.5 days of annual leave. Travel expense reimbursement and a solid pension scheme. A high-quality on-site restaurant offering fresh and healthy options daily. Excellent accessibility: the train station is located directly at our main entrance, and there is ample parking available. A contribution toward your personal gym or sports membership to support your well-being. A beautiful private park on site, ideal for a walk, break, or moment of relaxation. Mental well-being support via Lyra Health for you and your family members. Access to a dedicated prayer and meditation room. Extensive growth and development opportunities thanks to the size of the site and the presence of multiple disciplines and global departments represented in Boxmeer. A workplace within an organization that continues to grow and evolve. We are a global team of professionals working together to make a positive impact on animal care and the world’s food supply, with a strong sense of responsibility toward our customers, consumers, animals, society, and the planet. Through our commitment to The Science of Healthier Animals® , we provide veterinarians, farmers, pet owners, and governments with one of the broadest portfolios of veterinary pharmaceuticals, vaccines, and health management solutions and services. This includes an extensive range of digitally connected identification, traceability, and monitoring products. title: Lab Platform Engineer
description: Job Description ## About the Role We run the enterprise SaaS platforms, APIs, and data integrations that our research and manufacturing organisation depends on every day. When they break, science stops. You will be the engineer who owns a set of those platforms end to end: reliability, incidents, integrations, automation, and technical direction. This is a hands-on reliability and platform engineering role, not a ticket queue. You will own production, run the post-incident reviews, automate the manual work away, and decide where the platform goes next. Our platforms happen to serve laboratory and sample-management workflows, so you will learn that domain here - we do not expect you to arrive with it. ## What You Will Do ### Own production Act as technical owner for a portfolio of business-critical SaaS platforms and the integrations around them. Lead investigation and resolution of production incidents across application, API, data, identity, and network layers. Run blameless post-incident reviews, drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions to closure. Improve monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and operational metrics so the next incident is shorter - or does not happen. ### Engineer and integrate Build and maintain integrations between SaaS platforms, internal enterprise services, and legacy systems. Debug data-consistency and integration failures across APIs, event flows, and identity boundaries. Use AWS services and enterprise networking knowledge to diagnose and harden platform reliability. Support deployments, go-live readiness, rollback planning, and post-deployment stabilisation. ### Automate and use AI well Automate repetitive operational work - triage, checks, reporting, provisioning - with scripting and approved tooling. Use AI-assisted tooling for log analysis, incident triage, investigation, and knowledge capture, and validate its output against real platform evidence before acting on it. ### Set technical direction Prioritise technical work with product owners, and communicate risk, impact, and options to technical and non-technical audiences alike. Contribute to target-state architecture and technical roadmaps for your platforms. Lead technical engagement with vendors on incidents, defects, enhancements, and upgrades. Mentor less experienced engineers and contribute to engineering standards and documentation. ### Work in a regulated environment Follow established validation, change-control, and documentation practices - our platforms are audit-sensitive, and we will train you on what that means in practice. Identify security, access, and data-protection risks early and bring in security and architecture partners. ## What You Bring 4+ years engineering, operating, or owning production software platforms, SaaS solutions, or enterprise systems. Real production incident experience: you have been on the sharp end of an outage, led the investigation, and closed the loop afterwards. Solid debugging skills across the stack - application, API, data, identity, and network. Working knowledge of AWS and of enterprise networking fundamentals (DNS, TLS, firewalls, proxies, connectivity patterns). Scripting or development ability (Python or similar) for automation. Practical use of AI-assisted tools in engineering or operations work, with sound judgement about their output. Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to work with distributed teams across Europe, the US, and India. Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a life sciences field (biology, chemistry, biotechnology, bioinformatics, biomedical engineering, or similar) - or equivalent practical experience. We welcome scientists who moved into engineering. ## Nice to Have (Not Required) We will teach you the domain. Any of the following is a bonus, none is a filter: Observability tooling (Datadog, Grafana, Splunk, CloudWatch or similar). Infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, or containers. Experience in a regulated, GxP, or otherwise audit-sensitive environment. Scientific informatics platforms - LIMS, ELN, sample management - or specific products such as Benchling or ZONTAL. Awareness of IT/OT boundaries, network segmentation, and the Purdue Model / ISA-95 concepts used in laboratory and plant environments. Life sciences, pharma, research, or manufacturing IT background. ## Why This Role End-to-end ownership of platforms that directly enable drug discovery and development. A reliability practice you get to shape, not inherit fully formed. Genuine mandate to automate and to apply AI tooling to operations work. Prague-based team working closely with US and India engineering. ## What we offer Exciting work in a great team, global projects, international environment Opportunity to learn and grow professionally within the company globally Hybrid working model, flexible role pattern Competitive salary & incentive pay Pension and health insurance contributions Internal reward system and referral scheme 5 weeks annual leave, 5 sick days, 15 days of certified sick leave paid above statutory requirements annually, 40 paid hours annually for volunteering activities, 12 weeks of parental contribution Cafeteria for tax free benefits according to your choice (meal vouchers, sport, culture, health, travel, etc.), Multisport Card Vodafone, Raiffeisen Bank, Foodora, and discount programmes Up-to-date laptop and iPhone Parking in the garage, showers, refreshments, massage chairs, library, music corner Ready to take up the challenge? Working closely with fellow Operational Coaches and cross-functional partners including Maintenance & Reliability (M&R), Engineering, Automation, Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Control (QC), Supply Chain, Digital Manufacturing, and Project teams, the Operational Coach helps ensure the facility is prepared for commissioning, qualification, validation, and commercial operations. Purpose of the role The Operational Coach is responsible for building, developing, and leading a team of operators during the start-up and operational readiness phase of a new Blend & Fill manufacturing facility. The role is critical in establishing a high-performing organization capable of safely, compliantly, and efficiently operating a state-of-the-art manufacturing environment. The role combines people leadership, operational readiness, digital transformation, and hands-on involvement in facility start-up activities. Acting as a change leader, the Operational Coach fosters a culture of safety, quality, accountability, continuous improvement, operational excellence, and digital-first thinking from the earliest stages of facility operation. Tasks and responsibilities Organization & Team Development Recruit, onboard, train, and develop operators to build a high-performing operations team. Establish team structures, shift patterns, clear roles, and accountabilities. Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and innovation. Digital Manufacturing & Capability Building Prepare and coach operators for a fully paperless manufacturing environment. Drive adoption of digital manufacturing systems, electronic batch records, and data-driven workflows. This senior leadership role is responsible for driving late-stage and commercial biologics programs, focusing on upstream cell culture and commercialization. Key responsibilities include providing technical leadership in process characterization, ensuring regulatory compliance, collaborating across cross-functional teams, and fostering innovation and operational excellence. Candidates should possess deep expertise in upstream biologics processing, proven experience in commercialization and scale-up, and strong leadership skills. Preferred qualifications include people management skills, hands-on experience with advanced antibody therapeutics, regulatory submissions, and familiarity with analytical methods, cGMPs, and lean leadership principles. Educational requirements include a BS, MS, or PhD in a relevant discipline with substantial industry experience. Join Our Team as a Principal Scientist/ Director in Biologics Drug Substance Commercialization! Are you ready to make a significant impact in the world of cell culture process development & commercialization? At Our Company , we are at the forefront of innovation in the Manufacturing Division , specifically within the Biologics Drug Substance Commercialization (BDSC) team. Our Upstream Cell Culture department is seeking a passionate and skilled individual to lead the charge in transforming our late-stage pipeline and commercial products into reality. Position Overview Within Our Company’s Manufacturing Division, Biologics Drug Substance Commercialization (BDSC) provides upstream process leadership and laboratory capabilities that advance late-stage pipeline and commercial drug substance manufacturing for biologics. The BDSC organization plays a critical role in enabling licensure and commercial supply by delivering second generation process development, robust process characterization, and seamless technology transfer to internal and external manufacturing sites. The Principal Scientist/ Director position in BDSC-Upstream team is a senior scientific and leadership role supporting late stage and commercial biologics programs, with a primary focus on biologics upstream processing. This position offers the opportunity to lead high impact scientific work across complex modalities, including multi-specific antibody therapeutics—while developing talent and shaping upstream strategies that directly support global manufacturing and regulatory success. The Principal Scientist/ Director will serve as a key technical leader and collaborator across Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, and external partners. Key Responsibilities Scientific & Technical Leadership · Lead upstream and/or integrated drug substance teams supporting late-stage clinical and commercial programs, with clear line of sight to licensure and commercialization. · Provide technical leadership for laboratory scale and manufacturing scale studies supporting process characterization, validation, investigations, and continued process verification. · Serve as a upstream subject matter expert across core unit operations, with a strong understanding of downstream, analytical, and GMP manufacturing interdependencies. · Ensure process and product knowledge are developed, documented, and transferred in alignment with company standards and regulatory expectations. description: Job Description Especialista de Pruebas de Campo Nivel de Experiencia: Junior (Recién egresado o 1 año de experiencia) Área / Departamento: Servicio Técnico / Comercial (Salud Animal) Reporta a: Gerente Comercial Ubicación: Campo / San Juan de Los Lagos, Jalisco. Jornada Laboral: Tiempo completo (con disponibilidad para viajar y adaptarse a horarios de producción) 2. Objetivo General del Puesto Ejecutar, supervisar y auditar los protocolos de vacunación y el manejo de la cadena fría, en granjas porcinas (prioritariamente en Sitios 2 y 3). El ocupante del puesto será responsable de capacitar al personal operativo, realizar el seguimiento de parámetros productivos y sanitarios, detectar enfermedades de forma temprana, y recolectar y enviar muestras al laboratorio. Todo esto con el fin de asegurar la eficacia de los biológicos y proveer información técnica de valor para el soporte comercial y la toma de decisiones. 3. Responsabilidades y Funciones Clave A. Auditoría de Vacunación y Cadena fría Realizar auditorías periódicas del proceso de vacunación en granjas para asegurar la correcta dosificación, vía de administración e higiene. Supervisar y garantizar la integridad de la cadena de frío desde la recepción del producto biológico hasta su aplicación final en los animales. Evaluar las condiciones de los equipos de refrigeración, termos de transporte e instrumentos de aplicación (jeringas, agujas, etc.) en las granjas. B. Capacitación y Desarrollo de Personal Diseñar e impartir talleres prácticos y teóricos para los operarios de granja sobre buenas prácticas de vacunación y manejo de la cadena de frío. Fomentar una cultura de bioseguridad e higiene en los procesos de inmunización. C. Monitoreo Sanitario, Diagnóstico y Seguimiento en Rastro Realizar visitas periódicas de monitoreo para la detección temprana de signos clínicos de enfermedades comunes en porcinos de Sitios 2 (Destete/Transición) y 3 (Engorda/Finalización). Llevar a cabo la toma de muestras biológicas (sangre, fluidos orales, tejidos, hisopos) bajo estrictos protocolos de bioseguridad y coordinar su correcto embalaje y envío al laboratorio de diagnóstico. Realizar el seguimiento y evaluación en rastro (evaluaciones de lesiones pulmonares, de cornetes nasales, hígado, etc.) para correlacionar los hallazgos con el estatus sanitario de las granjas evaluadas. D. Seguimiento de Parámetros Productivos y Reportes Recopilar y analizar datos de parámetros productivos clave (ej. ganancia diaria de peso, conversión alimenticia, porcentaje de mortalidad, uniformidad de lote) relacionados con las pruebas de campo. Elaborar y entregar reportes técnicos detallados en tiempo y forma para el Gerente Comercial, aportando datos objetivos que respalden la efectividad del portafolio de productos. Mantener un registro ordenado, digitalizado e histórico de cada una de las pruebas de campo y auditorías realizadas. 4. Relaciones Clave e Interacciones El puesto requiere una alta habilidad de adaptación y comunicación, ya que interactúa constantemente con diversos perfiles del sector: Internas: Gerente Comercial: Reporte directo de actividades, resultados de pruebas de campo, alertas sanitarias y entrega de reportes. Equipo de Soporte Técnico: Coordinación para capacitaciones conjuntas y alineación de estrategias de salud animal. Externas: Dueños de Granja: Presentación de resultados consolidados e impacto económico/productivo de los programas de salud. Médicos Veterinarios / Asesores de la Granja: Discusión técnica de diagnósticos, programas vacunales y resultados de laboratorio. Supervisores de Granja: Coordinación logística de las visitas, auditorías y capacitaciones. Operarios de Granja: Trabajo hombro a hombro en la fosa/corral, capacitación práctica en la aplicación de productos y fomento de la confianza en campo. 5. Perfil del Candidato Requisitos Académicos Formación: Recién egresado o titulado de la carrera de Médico Veterinario Zootecnista (MVZ), Ingeniero Agrónomo Zootecnista o carrera afín al sector pecuario. Experiencia No requerida (se valorará positivamente haber realizado prácticas profesionales, servicio social o estancias en granjas porcinas). Máximo 1 año de experiencia en producción porcina, clínica de cerdos o servicio técnico de campo. Conocimientos Técnicos Requeridos (o con alta disposición para aprender) Conocimiento básico del ciclo productivo porcino (especialmente Sitio 2: Destete/Maternidad y Sitio 3: Engorda). Nociones de inmunología veterinaria, cadena de frío y bioseguridad en granjas. Manejo básico de herramientas de diagnóstico y toma de muestras. Manejo de paquetería Office básica (Excel para registro de datos, PowerPoint para presentaciones de capacitación, Word para reportes). Competencias Blandas y Habilidades Facilidad de palabra y empatía: Capacidad para comunicarse y ganarse la confianza tanto de un operario de granja como del dueño del negocio. Orientación al detalle y orden: Rigurosidad en el llenado de registros, mantenimiento de muestras y puntualidad en reportes. Capacidad de enseñanza (Habilidades pedagógicas): Gusto por capacitar y explicar procesos de forma sencilla y clara. Proactividad y autonomía: Capacidad para resolver problemas en campo bajo lineamientos de bioseguridad. Resiliencia y adaptabilidad: Disposición para trabajar en condiciones de granja (olores, clima, esfuerzo físico moderado) y rastro. 6. description: Job Description The Technical Operations Director is accountable for the operation of the Technical Operations Department. The role will serve on the Site Leadership Team (SLT) and will be responsible for developing the strategic manufacturing/technical roadmap for the facility. As member of the SLT, the incumbent will play a key role in the development of policy and co-ordination of overall site operations. The role plays a critical part in strategic project realization of the Wilmington Biotech facility, a new hi-potent facility in our Company’s Biologic manufacturing network, ensuring that site’s mission and objectives are effectively achieved, consistent with our Company's requirements to ensure compliance, safety and reliable supply to our customers. The Technical Operations Director is accountable for planning and on-time execution of commercialization activities of our pipeline products and routine clinical/commercial operations. This role will report into the Executive Director, Biologics Technical Organization, and will have the following functions reporting into the role:(1) Process Engineering (2) Site and Process Validation (3) Technical Operations support and (4) Technical Transfer activities. Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities Lead the site Technical Operations team. Identify, recruit and manage the Technical Operations Team at the site, implementing a strong quality culture and ensuring employee engagement and development in line with the site’s talent framework. description: Job Description We zijn op zoek naar een daadkrachtige en georganiseerde professional die energie krijgt van het plannen, coördineren en optimaliseren van onderhoudsprocessen in een hoogtechnologische productieomgeving. Voor onze Animal Health locatie in Boxmeer zoeken wij een: Technical Coördinator Welkom in ons team We staan aan de start van iets groots. In Boxmeer bouwen we een volledig nieuwe, zelfstandige divisie – een mini-site – rondom een innovatieve poederafvullijn. De fabriek is in aanbouw en het productieproces is nieuw. Omdat we wereldwijd producten leveren, inclusief de Verenigde Staten, richten we de site vanaf dag één in volgens de laatste EU-GMP- en FDA-kwaliteitsvereisten. De nieuwe divisie is verantwoordelijk voor alle GMP-gerelateerde activiteiten: van kwaliteitsmanagement en validatie tot training, documentatie en auditvoorbereiding. Then we are looking for you to join our Biosafety team! For our Animal Health location in Boxmeer we have the exciting opportunity for an: EHS Biosafety Officer Welcome to our team Our production and R&D (Research & Development) facilities in Boxmeer and De Bilt are part of our global Animal Health network and develop, manufacture and package animal health products according to Good Manufacturing Practices standards (GMP). Boxmeer, with its more than 2000 employees, is the largest site in our Animal Health's global network. Our Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) department (~21 employees) provides safety and environmental support for our animal health organization at the Boxmeer and De Bilt facilities to drive towards world class EHS performance. The department covers all the essential EHS expertise, with a team of now 7 individuals specializing in Biosafety & Industrial Hygiene (BS&IH). Purpose of the Role The EHS Biosafety Officer serves as the site’s biosafety expert, ensuring safe and compliant management of biological agents and GMO-related activities across R&D and manufacturing operations. The role supports the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of biosafety programs, risk assessments, biocontainment systems, and regulatory compliance to protect employees, products, and the environment while enabling safe and effective vaccine research and production. Primary responsibilities Subject Matter Expert for the Biosafety program of the site, including site processes to anticipate, recognize, and evaluate workplace health hazards and recommend proper control strategies to manage identified risks. Identify and assess Biosafety related risks, develop, and assist with defining and implementing corrective and preventive action plans. Monitor and communicate overall status of these plans. Proactively identify improvement opportunities and collaborate with other EHS staff/ Engineering, Operations and R&D personnel to leverage best practices and drive continuous improvement efforts. Maintain the required technical competencies, proficiencies, and regulatory knowledge to ensure responsibilities are effectively executed. Technical expertise needs to include but is not limited to risk assessment of biological operations; control strategies and prevention (including, engineering controls and work practice controls), applicable regulatory and requirements. Establish and maintain excellent communication processes to ensure site management, , as well as affected employees in R&D and Manufacturing understand the workplace biohazards and accompanying biological risks including exposure prevention methods and control strategies. Provide technical support for engineering projects and modifications to ensure proper Biocontainment facility design, containment verification, as well as evaluation before and after process / equipment is installed or implemented. Conduct biosafety program assessments, area inspections & audits. Develop and contribute to an effective Biosafety training program for both management and employees. Your profile Bachelor’s degree in microbiology / biotechnology (or similar) Industrial (occupational) hygiene (Arbeidshygiene) or Safety engineering (Hogere Veiligheidskunde) education is a plus. Experience with managing risks associated with biological agents, experience with GMO legislation (BVF permit), understanding of biocontainment systems and concepts. Ability to analyze data, interpret results/ trends, decide appropriate, cost-effective corrective actions and provide clear recommendations to both management and employees. Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, ability to work transparently and with a sense of urgency across various roles. Excellent technical leadership and communication (oral & written) skills in English and preferably also in Dutch. What we offer We provide an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact on the well-being of our employees and the environment. In this role, you will have autonomy and the freedom to take charge. Our benefits are very competitive, and the summary below will give you an idea of what you can expect. Competitive salary, depending on your knowledge and experience. 3% year-end payment and an annual bonus based on individual and company performance. A minimum of 35.5 days of leave. Travel allowance and a solid pension plan. A high-quality company restaurant offering fresh and healthy options daily. Excellent accessibility: the train station is located directly at our main entrance, and there is ample parking. A contribution toward your personal sports membership to support your vitality. A beautiful private park on-site, perfect for a walk, break, or moment of relaxation. Mental well-being support through Lyra Health for you and your family members. Access to a dedicated prayer/meditation room. Extensive growth opportunities, thanks to the size of the site and the many disciplines and global departments represented in Boxmeer. A workplace within an organization that is continuously growing and evolving. For questions about this vacancy Please send an email including the vacancy number and job title to the following email address: RecruitmentNL@MSD.com . Animal Health Our Animal Health Division is a trusted global leader in veterinary medicine, dedicated to preserving and improving health, well-being, and performance of animals and the people who care for them. We are a global team of professionals working together to make a positive difference in animal care and the world’s food supply and have a deep sense of responsibility towards our customers, consumers, animals, society, and our planet. Through our commitment to The Science of Healthier Animals®, we offer veterinarians, farmers, pet owners and governments one of the widest ranges of veterinary pharmaceuticals, vaccines and health management solutions and services as well as an extensive suite of digitally connected identification, traceability and monitoring products. We invest in dynamic and comprehensive R&D resources and a modern, global supply chain. We are present in more than 50 countries, while our products are available in some 150 markets. description: Job Description Our Human Health Division maintains a “patient first, profits later” ideology. The organization is comprised of sales, marketing, market access, digital analytics and commercial professionals who are passionate about their role in bringing our medicines to our customers worldwide. We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Account Manager to manage our existing Pulmonary Hypertension (PH) business and lead the launch of an exciting new product across the Swiss German part of Switzerland. This role requires strong expertise in pharmaceutical sales, strategic planning and relationship-building with key healthcare professionals. The Account Manager will also work closely with marketing to create and implement impactful materials, projects and campaigns. While experience in Pulmonary Hypertension and rare diseases is a plus, we welcome candidates with a strong background in pharmaceutical sales who are excited about launching a new product in a very specialized market. Responsibilities: Manage performance of Pulmonary Hypertension (PH) portfolio, lead the successful launch of a new Pulmonary arterial Hypertension (PAH) product, including market analysis, stakeholder engagement, implementation of launch strategy and monitor territory performance versus targets. Build and maintain long-term partnerships with customers (Scientific Leaders, Specialists and specialized Nurses), through individual sales visits, promotional lectures and participation in congresses and educational events. Drive tailored customer engagements, by using data and analytics to better understand the customer’s preference and by properly balancing physical and digital engagements.
